services.name: History comes alive with Dr. Chris Fonvielle
services.desc: 2 Hours "Welcome aboard, folks, as we set sail on the storied waters of the Cape Fear River. This river has seen it all—pirates, war, rebellion, and tragedy. If these waters could talk, they’d whisper tales of fortune and misfortune, courage and betrayal. As we push off from the dock, take a deep breath of that salty breeze—it carries the echoes of history. Keep your eyes on the banks, because every bend in this river tells a tale, and we’re about to uncover the hidden past of Wilmington, North Carolina. blurb: Join Wilmington Water Tours and Jill Peleuses from Wild Bird & Garden, for a peaceful morning birding excursion on the Cape Fear River. As we cruise down the river we will point out the birds we see and discuss their habitats and habits. The Cape Fear area is a perfect spot for our feathered friends. This birding trip will give you a look at the birds that make the Cape Fear River their home.
